---
title: "Procedure-specific evidence for preoperative uterine and cervical evaluation"
format: docx
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| label: tbl-procedure-evidence
#| tbl-cap: "Published evidence and missing model inputs by intended prolapse procedure."

evidence_rows <- tibble::tribble(
  ~Procedure, ~Organs, ~Evidence, ~Postoperative_consequence, ~Evidence_gap,
  "TVH + USLS", "Neither", "Occult EC 30/5,376 (0.56%) in mixed POP hysterectomy cohort [2]", "Unexpected EC; possible staging", "Route-specific staging probability and cost",
  "USLS hysteropexy", "Uterus + cervix", "Pooled malignancy 0.6%; NOT procedure-specific [1]", "Delayed EIN/EC; later hysterectomy", "Time to diagnosis and treatment",
  "SSLS hysteropexy", "Uterus + cervix", "Same mixed-population evidence [1]", "Delayed EIN/EC; later hysterectomy", "Time to diagnosis and treatment",
  "TLH + mesh SCP", "Neither", "Mixed POP hysterectomy cohort [2]", "Unexpected EC; possible staging", "Incremental staging time and cost",
  "SCH + mesh SCP", "Cervix", "Dysplasia indication in 18.2% of 137 selected trachelectomies after SCH [3]", "Occult corpus pathology; possible trachelectomy", "Absolute probability of subsequent trachelectomy",
  "Mesh sacral hysteropexy", "Uterus + cervix", "Uterus-preserving subgroup 0.50% screened vs 0.58% unscreened malignancy [1]", "Delayed EIN/EC; later surgery with mesh", "Added complexity and costs of reoperation"
)

knitr::kable(evidence_rows)
```

**Important qualifications.** Estimates are not surgery-specific transition probabilities. The pooled malignancy prevalence is not EIN prevalence. The trachelectomy indication percentages are conditional on undergoing trachelectomy, not the risk after SCH. The screened-versus-unscreened finding does not establish screening efficacy. Patients with postmenopausal bleeding or guideline-indicated cervical evaluation are excluded from the asymptomatic primary comparison.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-parameter-gaps
#| tbl-cap: "Cross-cutting parameters needing evidence review."

parameter_gaps <- tibble::tribble(
  ~Parameter, ~Status,
  "EIN prevalence in asymptomatic postmenopausal prolapse patients", "Missing",
  "Endometrial test sensitivity, specificity, and inadequate-sample rate", "Target-population estimates missing",
  "CIN2+/AIS/cervical cancer by age and prior screening", "Missing",
  "Second staging after occult EC on hysterectomy pathology", "10/30 (33.3%) in one cohort [2]",
  "Delayed cancer diagnosis after hysteropexy", "Missing",
  "Probability of trachelectomy among all SCH recipients", "Missing",
  "Incremental operative duration, cost, QALY effects", "Missing",
  "Guideline-eligible future cervical screening for retained cervix", "Requires age/screening history"
)
knitr::kable(parameter_gaps)
```

**Sources**

1. Patient Risk Factors for Incidental Pathology After Uterovaginal Surgery for Apical Prolapse: Systematic Review and Global Expert Consensus Statements. 2026. https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42811185/
2. Incidence and Outcomes of Occult Uterine Cancer in Uteri Removed for Prolapse. 2025. https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12681478/
3. Retrospective analysis of secondary resection of the cervical stump after subtotal hysterectomy: why and when? 2021. https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC8553675/
